_note: Signature talk topics shown on the homepage and Speaking page. Structure: title, description, audience, format.

topics.title: Money, Rules, and Political Pressure
topics.description: How central banks, elected officials, and public expectations shape monetary policy. A historically grounded talk on inflation, institutional credibility, and the limits of discretion.
topics.audience: General audiences, policy forums, donor events

topics.title: Sound Money and Monetary Rules
topics.description: What economic history reveals about discretionary monetary policy, and why predictable rules can discipline institutions better than good intentions alone.

topics.title: Public Choice and Political Incentives
topics.description: A practical introduction to public-choice economics: how incentives shape the behavior of voters, elected officials, agencies, and interest groups.

topics.title: How to Read an Economy in the News
topics.description: A working economist's guide to inflation, interest rates, labor markets, and fiscal policy, with an emphasis on separating useful signals from daily noise.
